release_read.basis: Q3 bookings $316.1m (+12%) beat the company's own guide (search snippet cites $307m) and DAU growth accelerated to 29%; the Q4 bookings guide of $382m (+13%) meets/exceeds the ~$380m the held FY guide implied and FY bookings is raised to $1,296m from $1,285m, so the re-acceleration the short thesis doubted is now both started and guided. Offsets: adj. EBITDA margin 25.5% vs 29.5% a year ago and a Q4 gross-margin step-down on AI costs.

public_reaction.summary: One search for this morning's analyst actions returned nothing dated 2026-11-04; no time left for press or retail tone. Positioning (not reaction): ~18% of float short per the judges' notes, a squeeze fuel for the gap.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 156.5 = +22.3% vs prev close 128.0, against my frozen release read of +7%, an option-implied 13.5% and a best past reaction of +21.6%. Pre-market is alive (78 prints, 14 in last 30m, last print 09:15) and was still climbing: after-hours 143.29 (+11.9%), pre-market low 142.0, high = last = 157.21. A short being squeezed (18% of float) explains part of the overshoot. Short position is -16.7% vs entry.

thesis_check.note: The short rested on the held FY bookings guide requiring a Q4 re-acceleration the company would not deliver; Q3 already printed +12%, Q4 is guided +13% and FY bookings was raised.

expected.open_lag_note: Active pre-market (14 prints in the last 30 min, last at 09:15, not stale) so the open should hold the move; a +22% gap, far beyond the 13.5% implied move and roughly three times what the release supports on my read, is the kind that gives some back in the first half hour, though the pre-market was still making highs into 09:15 and short covering can carry the open higher first.

recommendation.reason: De cijfers spreken de short-these tegen en het aandeel staat voorbeurs ruim 22% hoger, bijna het dubbele van de door opties verwachte beweging en veel meer dan de cijfers zelf rechtvaardigen; daar zit waarschijnlijk dekking door shortsellers in. Zo'n grote opening geeft vaak een deel terug in het eerste halfuur, dus dek de verliezende short om 10:00 in plaats van in de opening.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de voorbeurskoers voor 09:30 terugzakt richting 145-150 (de piek al voorbij), of er komen nieuwe koersdoelverhogingen of een bericht dat de prognose voor 2027 sterk is, dan toch bij de opening dekken.
